posts.text: Corporations have been breaking promises for decades with zero consequences. IRIS changes that. Every violation documented. Every broken commitment recorded. Immutable. Searchable. Permanent. The record does not forget and neither do we. omaro.org

The Out Ledger is coming to IRIS as its Company record. Every corporate violation it documents gets pinned to IPFS. Immutable, dual-linked, permanent. Companies can pay fines, issue apologies, and rebrand. The record stays. omaro.org

We built OMARO because accountability should not depend on who has the best lawyers. IRIS's Company record is a permanent, verifiable ledger of corporate conduct indexed by company, tagged by impact, open to the public. No ads. No data brokers. No optimized outrage. Just infrastructure that tells the truth and treats you like a human.
